summary: Style rules for the boxes on the earth observation page, including the teaser, safety, metadata, summary, and traceability boxes.
purpose: Gives the satellite observation boxes a consistent border, background, and spacing.
why: Reason not stated in the code. It appears to match the other boxes in the app.
how: Sets a shared box style with a border, background, rounded corners, and padding. Adds a green tint to the teaser box and extra spacing for the paragraphs inside each box.
inputs: None. This file only holds style rules.
outputs: The visual look of the observation page boxes.
risks: The whole file is one line, so edits are easy to get wrong. Class names must match the page.
debug: If boxes look wrong, check that the page uses these class names and that the color variables exist in the global styles.
